function.name: render_forex_chart
function.description: Draw a candlestick chart image from live MT5 candles (built by the app, shown in the chat, no vision model needed). Call it when the user wants to SEE or CHANGE a chart / screenshot / picture (arrows, FVG, highs and lows, white background). Not for analysis, forecasts or explanations: use get_market_analysis.

timeframe.description: Omit to keep the one used earlier in the conversation.

overlays.description: fvg = Fair Value Gaps. scenario = the app itself draws the arrow of the MOST PROBABLE scenario with SL/TP (do NOT call get_market_analysis first). swings = swing highs (سقف) and lows (کف). To edit the previous chart repeat its overlays and add the new ones.

price.description: Price where the item starts / sits.

bar.description: Candle offset from the last one: 0 = last, -5 = five ago, 10 = ahead.

label.description: Short Latin/digit label, e.g. BUY, TP1, SL 2650.

annotations.description: Extra arrows / markers / lines / labels; only prices from data in this conversation.

function.name: get_market_analysis
function.description: Fetch live MT5 data and the indicator/level digest for an ANALYSIS question (trend, support/resistance, scenarios, entries, backtests). Call it before answering any analysis or forecast question about an instrument; not when the user only wants a picture.

symbols.description: Instruments (max 3); omit to use the ones from the conversation.

timeframe.description: Trading timeframe if the user named one.
